# vLLM V1 整体架构图谱 ## 总览：请求流转全链路 ```mermaid flowchart TD C["外部 Client"] -->|HTTP 请求| API["API Server Process"] API -->|解析 & 预处理| IP["Input Processor (Input Thread)"] IP -->|调度请求| SCH["Scheduler"] SCH -->|生成调度计划| EC["Engine Call Process"] EC -->|调用执行器| EX["Executor (UnitProc / Multi‑Process)"] EX -->|GPU 计算| GPU["GPU Work Process / Model Runner"] GPU -->|生成输出| OP["Output Processor (Output Thread)"] OP -->|返回响应| C ``` ## 边界层次划分 ```mermaid flowchart LR NB["网络边界
(Client ↔ HTTP Server)"] PB["进程边界
(API Server ↔ Engine Call)"] TB["线程边界
(Input/Output Thread ↔ 主线程)"] DB["设备边界
(GPU Work Process ↔ GPU 硬件)"] NB --> PB PB --> TB TB --> DB DB -->|跨越| NB ``` ## 调度器决策流程 ```mermaid flowchart TD REQ["接收请求"] --> TOK["计算请求所需 Token 数"] TOK --> BLK["分配 Block（KV Cache）"] BLK --> PLAN["生成调度计划"] PLAN -->|计划输出| SCH_OUT["Scheduler Output"] SCH_OUT -->|发送| EXEC["Executor"] EXEC -->|执行| RUN["运行模型"] RUN -->|完成| DONE["调度完成"] ``` ## 执行路径与 GPU 计算 ```mermaid flowchart TD START["Executor 调用"] --> UNIT["UnitProc Execute (同进程)"] START --> MP["Multi‑Process Execute (跨进程)"] UNIT --> GPU_RUN["GPU Model Runner"] MP --> GPU_RUN GPU_RUN --> PREP["准备 Block Table & KV Cache"] PREP --> ATT["执行 Attention 计算"] ATT --> MAT["矩阵乘法等算子"] MAT --> OUT["生成模型输出"] OUT --> RETURN["返回至 Output Processor"] ```
